topic: Progressive overload: add a little every week

scenes.text: Lifting the same fucking weight for months? That's why nothing changes.
Same plates, same reps, week after fucking week. Your body has no reason to grow.
Log week one. Next week, add one fucking rep. Then another rep. Then a little more weight on the bar.
Small jumps. Write every lift down, and keep your form tight as fuck.
A little more every week. That's how you fucking grow.

caption: Lifting the same weight for months and nothing changes? Log every lift, then add one rep or a little weight each week with clean form. Small jumps add up. Save this for your next gym day.
